a = Set([12, 5, 8, 21, 5, 17, 3, 12, 9])
b = Set([8, 14, 21, 6, 14, 3, 25, 6])
for (label, result) in [
    ("union", union(a, b)),
    ("intersection", intersect(a, b)),
    ("difference", setdiff(a, b)),
    ("symmetric difference", symdiff(a, b)),
]
    println(label, ": ", join(sort(collect(result)), " "))
end
